title: Create a util library
description: Creates an Angular util library inside an existing domain.

name.description: Util library name, for example date.
name.x-prompt: What util name would you like to use?

domain.description: Existing domain name, for example booking. Omit this to place the library in shared.

directory.description: Optional nested path under the domain folder where the util library is created.

skipPrefix.description: Skip the util- prefix in the project name and folder. Same as --skip-prefix.

dryRun.description: Preview the changes without updating files. Same as --dry-run.
